core.name: vLLM
core.qualification: vLLM/vLLM Metal 0.29.0 qualified with Qwen3 0.6B 4-bit on M2 Max; no CUDA feature parity implied.

excluded.name: Hugging Face TGI
excluded.reason: Archived repository; maintainers recommend other serving engines.

decision.reason: User requested one working pilot before choosing the rest. Ollama was already installed and provides model management plus local inference.
decision.product_direction: Harness plus the conversational agent provides model management. Prioritize direct engines and valuable advanced capabilities over additional overlapping manager applications.
decision.framework_backend_policy: One harness per framework; vLLM Metal is the Apple Silicon backend inside vLLM.

benchmark_scope: Separate Ollama, MLX-LM and vLLM Metal small-model warm measurements on this M2 Max. vLLM also measures bounded concurrent client requests. Different timing/cache definitions; no controlled cross-framework ranking.
